name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Navigator goes with Basalt if and only if Navigator does not go with Bauer.
Between Cho and Okafor, one goes with Captain and the other with Engineer.
Captain does not go with Plankton.
Either Lichen goes with Fontaine or Algae goes with Technician.
Between Bauer and Rios, one goes with Algae and the other with Diatoms.
Basalt goes with at least one of Fontaine, Okafor, or Pilot.
Okafor goes with neither Captain nor Pilot.
Rios, Engineer, and Plankton belong to different colonists.
